visual_action: A montage of video clips and still photos shows Karoline Leavitt in various settings at the White House. She is seen at the press briefing podium, standing in the Oval Office by the Resolute Desk, posing for a photo with another woman, and speaking to a large crowd of reporters on the White House grounds.

cast.name: Karoline Leavitt
cast.evidence: Karoline Leavitt is the sole subject of the video montage and is identified by face recognition. The caption 'America’s Press Sec✨🇺🇸' also refers to her.

on_screen_text.text: cause I always had a vision

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue. The audio consists of song lyrics which are also displayed on-screen: "And it's feminine intuition 'cause I always had a vision of me standing like this."
audio_music: An upbeat, aspirational pop song ('drop dead' by Olivia Rodrigo) plays throughout the video, creating an empowering and celebratory tone.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage of short clips and photos edited to the rhythm of the music.
cultural_references: The song 'drop dead' by pop star Olivia Rodrigo is used as the soundtrack.
central_claim: Karoline Leavitt has fulfilled her long-held dream of becoming the White House Press Secretary.
intended_effect: To inspire viewers and portray Karoline Leavitt as an accomplished, aspirational figure.
